title: Organiser news: 57,464 finishers and 2026 field demographics
publisher: A.S.O. — Schneider Electric Marathon de Paris official news
claims: The 49th edition on 12 April 2026 had exactly 58,853 starters; 57,464 crossed the finish line.
The 2026 field was 49% first-time marathoners, 33% women and 29% international participants, with an average age of 38.
Women's share was 33% in 2026, against 31% in 2025, 28% in 2024 and 25% in 2022; first-time marathoners were 41% in 2022.
Around 8,500 runners wore charity bibs (6,000 in 2025), raising more than €8.5 million for 300 organisations.
The event counted about 200,000 spectators and 40 entertainment zones along the course; the start was on the Champs-Élysées and the finish on Avenue Foch.
Among international participants, runners from the United Kingdom were the most represented after France, followed by the United States.
